title: Final Force Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the total force on charge +q.

title: Final Work Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the work done against electrostatic forces.

title: Final Surface Charge Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the surface charge density at the specified point.

title: Method of Images
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the method of images to find the forces acting on the charges.

title: Work Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct integration steps for calculating the work done in assembling the charges.

title: Electric Field Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the electric field at the point just above the conducting plane.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in force and work calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
